purpose: 共用工具處理 ERA5 下載、完整性检查、年最大值及 AR6；不表示 50 年資料已齊備。
raw_data_location: external disk; specify the actual input/output directory in each CLI call

coordinate_policy.source: EPSG:4326; keep original lon/lat and GRID identity
coordinate_policy.order: annual maxima -> land/region labels and predictor alignment -> regional metric coordinates -> spatial folds/buffers
coordinate_policy.global_buffer: WGS84 geodesic km, or regional projected distances with an explicit distortion audit
coordinate_policy.global_gp: regional validated projected coordinates; spherical alternatives require valid covariance models and separate implementation

required_work: 資料完整性、臺灣國界/本島遮罩及全球候選變數對齊尚需依真實資料驗證。
